pinLegend.title: Map pins
pinLegend.body: The percentage shows the share of outdoor seats we think are in direct sun at the selected time.

timeSlider.title: Choose time
timeSlider.body: You do not need to change anything — the map shows what is happening right now. To plan ahead, choose a date and time. The farther ahead you look, the less certain the forecast becomes.

datePlanner.title: Plan a date
datePlanner.body: Open the date picker when you want to plan a few days ahead. Today is shown when live mode applies.

tagChips.title: Filter venues
tagChips.body: Use tags to narrow the map and list to the kind of outdoor seating you are looking for.

venueList.title: Compare the list
venueList.body: The list sorts venues by sun or distance. After opening a venue, you can later answer whether the sun prediction matched.

favourites.title: Save favourites
favourites.body: Save places you want to revisit. Favourites are free and use the same sun forecast as the map.

pinLegend.sunnyDescription: Direct sun at the selected time.
